## Like a museum curator

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
      <article class="lesson-card">
        <h3>Select</h3>
        <p>Does this piece belong in the collection?</p>
      </article>
    </div>
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
      <article class="lesson-card">
        <h3>Arrange</h3>
        <p>Where will a learner encounter it?</p>
      </article>
    </div>
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="2">
      <article class="lesson-card">
        <h3>Label</h3>
        <p>What title makes it discoverable?</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="3">
    <div role="note" class="lesson-aside">The supervisor owns the preview and publication.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## What contributors hand you

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>bias-submission/</h3>
      <div class="file-row fragment custom sa-focus-plain" data-fragment-index="0"><code>overview.md</code>
        <small>Overview</small>
      </div>
      <div class="file-row fragment custom sa-focus-plain" data-fragment-index="1"><code>operating-point.md</code>
        <small>Topic</small>
      </div>
      <div class="file-row fragment custom sa-focus-plain" data-fragment-index="2"><code>images/curve.svg</code>
        <small>Figure</small>
      </div>
      <div class="file-row fragment custom sa-focus-plain" data-fragment-index="3"><code>worksheet.pdf</code>
        <small>Attachment</small>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>What the site does</h3>
      <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
        <p>The landing page introduces the module.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
        <p>A topic becomes a page in reading order.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="2">

```

## Check the folder first {auto-animate="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Archive</h3>
      <pre><code>bias.zip</code>
    </pre>
  </article>
  <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Extract and inspect</h3>
      <pre><code>python3 scripts/contribution_to_qmd.py bias/ --dry-run</code>
    </pre>
  </article>
</div>
<div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <article class="lesson-card" data-id="folder">
    <h3>Submission</h3>
    <pre><code>bias/
  overview.md
  operating-point.md
  images/curve.svg</code>
  </pre>
</article>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="2">
  <div role="note" class="lesson-aside">Dry run: inspect the proposed changes and warnings before writing files.</div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Migrate a document

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Document editor</h3>
      <div class="paper">
        <strong>Bias point</strong>
        <hr>
        <p>The curve crosses the load line.</p>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 140 46" width="140" aria-label="Example curve">
          <path d="M3 42 Q62 40 135 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </article>
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
      <article class="lesson-card">
        <h3>Markdown export</h3>
        <pre><code># Bias point
The curve crosses the load line.

![Curve](data:image/png;base64,…)</code>
      </pre>
    </article>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div role="note" class="lesson-aside">Compare the export with the original, including embedded figures.</div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Choose a conversion path

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
      <article class="lesson-card">
        <h3>Convert</h3>

      </pre>
      <p>Generate a page and review the report.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
  <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Keep Markdown</h3>
      <pre><code>overview.md → overview.md</code>
    </pre>
    <p>Place a prose page directly when that is intentional.</p>
  </article>
</div>
</div>
</div>
```

## What the script does {auto-animate="true"}

```{=html}

[Next](next.qmd)</code>

</div>
<div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">

⚠ unresolved link</code>

</article>
</div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Read the warnings {auto-animate="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <article class="lesson-card" data-id="report">
      <h3>Conversion report</h3>
      <pre><code>overview.qmd
⚠ unresolved link</code>
    </pre>
  </article>
  <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Warning</h3>
      <p>Inspect the unresolved link. Conversion can continue.</p>
    </article>

  <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="1">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Error</h3>
      <p>The script stops. Resolve the failure before continuing.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <svg class="lesson-flow" viewBox="0 0 820 108" role="img" aria-label="Preview before you push">
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="0">
      <rect x="12" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="90" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Build</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="1" pathLength="1" d="M169 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="217" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="295" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Serve</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="2">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="2" pathLength="1" d="M374 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="422" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="500" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Inspect</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="3">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="3" pathLength="1" d="M579 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>

      <text x="705" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Test</text>

    <circle class="lesson-traveler" cx="90" cy="18" r="7" aria-hidden="true"/>
  </svg>
  <div class="lesson-notes">
    <p class="lesson-prompt">How does a local edit become a checked preview?</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="0">Run <code>make full-preview</code>.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="1">Open localhost:8000. Use PORT=9000 if the port is occupied.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="2">Check the layout, images, sidebar and links.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="3">Run <code>make test</code> before publishing.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <svg class="lesson-flow" viewBox="0 0 1025 108" role="img" aria-label="Publish to main">
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="0">
      <rect x="12" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="90" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Test</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="1" pathLength="1" d="M169 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="217" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="295" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Commit</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="2">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="2" pathLength="1" d="M374 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="422" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="500" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Push</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="3">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="3" pathLength="1" d="M579 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="627" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="705" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Pipeline</text>
    </g>
    <g class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="4">
      <path class="fragment sa-draw" data-fragment-index="4" pathLength="1" d="M784 52h46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="832" y="18" width="157" height="68" rx="8"/>
      <text x="910" y="61" text-anchor="middle">Live</text>
    </g>
    <circle class="lesson-traveler" cx="90" cy="18" r="7" aria-hidden="true"/>
  </svg>
  <div class="lesson-notes">
    <p class="lesson-prompt">What has to happen between a passing test and a live page?</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="0">Confirm the local checks pass.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="1">Use a descriptive commit message and credit the contributor.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="2">Push the reviewed change to main.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="3">Watch the pipeline run.</p>
    <p class="fragment current-visible" data-fragment-index="4">Confirm the published page and send its location to the contributor.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Cross-check

```{=html}
<div class="lesson-stage">
  <div class="lesson-grid">
    <article class="lesson-card">
      <h3>Question</h3>
      <p>What do you inspect before converting the folder?</p>
    </article>
    <div class="fragment sa-enter-up" data-fragment-index="0">
      <article class="lesson-card answer">
        <h3>Answer</h3>
        <p>The dry-run report, proposed placement and unresolved references.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```


<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const bind = () => {
    for (const flow of document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-flow')) {
      const token = flow.querySelector('.lesson-traveler');
      const stops = Array.from(flow.querySelectorAll('g rect'), rect =>
        Number(rect.getAttribute('x')) + Number(rect.getAttribute('width')) / 2);
      SlideAnimations.bindState(flow, {
        initial: {x: stops[0], opacity: 0},
        steps: stops.map((x, index) => ({index, state: {x, opacity: 1}})),
        duration: 550,
        render: ({x, opacity}) => SlideAnimations.attrs(token, {cx: x, opacity})
      });
    }
  };
  if (Reveal.isReady()) bind();
  else Reveal.on('ready', bind);
});
</script>
